rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday way to describe someone or their behaviour as impolite or rude.

example.english: Interrupting people like that is really impolite.
example.traditional: 你咁樣打斷人哋講嘢，真係好冇禮貌。
example.jyutping: nei5 gam3 joeng2 daa2 tyun5 jan4 dei6 gong2 je5 zan1 hai6 hou2 mou5 lai5 maau6

rows.note: Use this when the behaviour is especially socially embarrassing or reflects badly on the person, rather than simply lacking manners.

example.english: Starting to eat before the host does at someone else's home is really impolite.
example.traditional: 喺人哋屋企食飯，唔等主人開餐就食，真係好失禮。
example.jyutping: hai2 jan4 dei6 uk1 kei2 sik6 faan6 m4 dang2 zyu2 jan4 hoi1 caan1 zau6 sik6 zan1 hai6 hou2 sat1 lai5
